# Tansley Parcel QBR (Fort Worth)

**Date:** 14 Oct 2025  
**Attendees:** Lev Arkadin (Procurement Lead, TPCL), Darla Vance (Fort Worth Yard Ops, TPCL), Pree (Pemberline)

## Ops & Product Usage
* Fort Worth site (Doors 1–28) handling early morning sort well, but evening cross-dock shift (18:00–02:00) still has manual overrides on Doors 14 and 15 when linehaul trailers arrive early from Waco.
* Darla flagged that the Gate Turnaround Report is including bobtail drop-offs in the dwell time average. Ticket #48109 open with support to filter out tractor-only check-ins.
* Permissions cleanup: Lev's admin account in Pemberline Dock is still getting spammed with SMS alerts for late carrier arrivals at the Waco yard. Removed his number from the shift escalation group during the call; Darla will take those alerts going forward.
* Driver kiosk at the North Gate lost Wi-Fi twice last week during heavy rain. Local IT is running a hardline by 24 Oct 2025; no action needed on our side.

## Upcoming Changes
* Lev's company is adding two depots next spring (Abilene and Tyler). 
* Groundbreaking on Abilene is done; Tyler lease closes in November. 
* Both sites will run the standard Pemberline Dock check-in flow with license plate cameras at the guard shack. Lev wants to review hardware specs for the kiosk tablets before they place their Q4 equipment order.

## Action Items
* **Pree:** Check status on Ticket #48109 (bobtail filter) and reply to Darla by 17 Oct 2025.
* **Pree:** Send updated kiosk tablet spec sheet to Lev.
* **Darla:** Send CSV of seasonal carrier SCACs for the November peak upload by 31 Oct 2025.
